aggregation: replica-mean: c_obs is the mean over replicas of each replica's c(y); n_hat_mean_of_replicas is the mean of the per-replica N_hat, the aggregation of the findings tables
estimator: N_hat = (sum c_obs / 2) / V_hat, V_hat = mean(c_obs * sign(c_ideal))

identity.domain: every bin decided with |c_ideal| = 1; |V_hat| above the code's guard of 1e-9
